THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, No. 28 of 1964 (Chapter 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: කැළ/7/ඉඅ/2/197 (3 සැතȚම) .

I, hereby give notice, under Sub - section (1) of Section 7, of Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:-

Hundred and Thirtyseven (137) allotments of land in total extent of about 1.0492 Hectares depicted in the Preliminary Plan No. P. P. Gam 3788 dated 16.05.2011 and an allotment bearing No. 300 in extent of about 0.0533 Hectare depicted in amended Preliminary Plan No. P. P. Gam 3788 dated 12.10.2015 prepared by Senior Superintendent of Surveys - Gampaha District, situated in the village called Kelaniya in Adhikarippatuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kelaniya in Gampaha District of Western Province and morefully described as follows.
